===Urizen Lore===
This ritual is part of [[Urizen magical traditions#Urizen Lore|Urizen lore]] rather than Imperial lore. Any Urizen character with the appropriate lore can master or [[Rituals#Performing_a_Ritual|perform]] this ritual. A character from another nation who mastered the ritual before it became part of Urizen lore may still perform it, but does so under the [[Formulaic_ritual#Ritual_Texts|usual rules]] for performing a ritual learned from a ritual text.
